docs.title: Totly
docs.text: Totly is a baby tracker that helps you and your family keep up with your little one's day — feedings, sleep, diapers, growth and more — all in one place.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Quick logging — Start a sleep or nursing timer, or log a bottle, diaper, medicine or growth measurement from the home screen in a few taps.
  • Reports — See every activity as a list or a timeline, and filter by the activities you care about.
  • Growth charts — Track weight, height and head circumference against the WHO Child Growth Standards' percentiles.
  • Family sharing — Invite a partner or caregiver by email, and everyone sees the same babies and logs on their own devices.

docs.title: Contact
docs.text: Have questions or feedback? Reach out to us at support@plusmobileapps.com.

docs.title: About
docs.text: Totly is built with Kotlin Multiplatform. All business logic is shared Kotlin, rendered with Compose Multiplatform on Android and desktop and with native SwiftUI on iOS.

docs.title: Shared
docs.text:
• Kotlin Multiplatform - shared code across Android, desktop and iOS
  • App Platform - presenters, renderers, scopes and module structure
  • Metro - compile-time dependency injection
  • Coroutines - asynchronous code and flows
  • kotlinx-datetime - multiplatform date time library
  • SQLDelight - sqlite database
  • multiplatform-settings - key value storage
  • moko-resources - localized strings shared with iOS
  • BuildKonfig - build-time configuration

docs.title: Client
docs.text:
• Compose Multiplatform - Android and desktop UI, Material 3 and icons
  • Navigation 3 - back stacks for the Compose UI
  • AndroidX Activity - Android entry point
  • SwiftUI - native iOS UI

docs.title: Server
docs.text:
• Supabase - auth, database, storage and edge functions
  • supabase-kt - Kotlin Multiplatform Supabase client
  • Ktor - HTTP client (OkHttp on Android and desktop, Darwin on iOS)

docs.title: Testing
docs.text:
• Kotlin test - KMP testing framework
  • AssertK - assertions

docs.title: Download Totly
docs.text: Totly is coming soon to iOS and Android.

docs.title: What is Totly?
docs.text: Totly is a baby tracker for logging feedings, sleep, diapers, growth and medicine, and for sharing those logs with your family.

docs.title: Is Totly free to use?
docs.text: Totly is free to download and use. Premium features may be added in the future, but everything is free today.

docs.title: What platforms is Totly available on?
docs.text: Totly is coming to iOS and Android.

docs.title: Do I need an account?
docs.text: No. You can track your baby on a single device without signing in. Create an account when you want to back up your logs or share them with family.

docs.title: How do I share my baby with a partner or caregiver?
docs.text: Sign in, then go to More → Manage Family, pick your baby, start a family and invite members by email. They'll see the invite under More → Notifications.

docs.title: How do I remove someone from my family?
docs.text: Go to More → Manage Family, pick your baby, and tap Remove next to the member. To leave a family yourself, tap Leave family.

docs.title: How do I delete my account?
docs.text: Email support@plusmobileapps.com from the address you signed up with and ask us to delete your account. We'll permanently delete your account, your profile and all babies, logs and photos you've added.

docs.title: What happens to my data when I sign out?
docs.text: Signing out uploads any pending changes, then deletes the babies and logs stored on that device. Sign back in to download them again.

docs.title: How do I report a bug?
docs.text: Please contact us at support@plusmobileapps.com with a description of the issue and your device information.

docs.title: You've been invited to a family on Totly
docs.text:
Someone invited you to help track their little one on Totly. Accept the invite in the app to see the same babies and logs on your own device.

Open the invite in Totly

docs.title: Accepting the invite
docs.text:
1. Install Totly and sign in with the email address the invite was sent to.
  2. Open More › Notifications.
  3. Tap Accept, or Decline if you weren't expecting it.

Didn't get here from an invite email? Ask the person who invited you to send it again from More › Manage family.

docs.title: Information Collection and Use
docs.text:
You can use Totly without an account, in which case everything you log stays on your device. If you create an account, we collect and store the following so we can sync it across your devices and share it with the family members you invite:

  • Account information — your email address, name and, optionally, a profile photo.
  • Baby information — the name, birthday, sex and, optionally, a photo of each baby you add.
  • Activity logs — the sleeps, feedings, diapers, growth measurements, medicines and notes you log.

Baby information and activity logs are visible only to you and the members of that baby's family. We do not sell your information or use it for advertising.

The app uses a third-party service to store this information on our behalf:

  • Supabase

Cookies are files with a small amount of data that are commonly used as anonymous unique identifiers. These are sent to your browser from the websites that you visit and are stored on your device's internal memory.

This Service does not use these "cookies" explicitly. However, the app may use third-party code and libraries that use "cookies" to collect information and improve their services. You have the option to either accept or refuse these cookies and know when a cookie is being sent to your device. If you choose to refuse our cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of this Service.

Information about a baby is entered by their parent or caregiver, who controls it and can delete it at any time. We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so that we can delete it.
